aggregation: Equal weight per registry setting x launch, with equal baseline-model/model-baseline order weight
latency_statistic: Geometric mean of six arm p50s (three per order), not a pooled median; speedup is six paired ratios GM
provenance_note: Input JSON bytes are hashed; recorded source/library/model fingerprints are retained, not rehashed against the current worktree
win_loss_note: Win/loss uses speedup >/< 1, not statistical significance; regression percent = (model/baseline - 1)*100
balance_note: Exactly one complete run per CP4/order with the same long-registry setting/launch subset and identical source hashes; --require-full additionally requires all 24 settings x Eager/Graph; unchanged configurations and regressions remain

reference_comparison.threshold_definition: GM of archived external/Fuse ratios over the full CP4 long QKV setting x launch scope; never fitted to current winners
reference_comparison.archive_fingerprint_note: Reference wide JSON and companion metadata bytes are hashed by the CLI; upstream recorded hashes are retained, not rehashed here
reference_comparison.timing_note: Archived values are their original p50s; current arm latency is the GM of six p50s, not a 50-sample median or pooled median
reference_comparison.comparison_note: External timings are archived cross-run references, not new paired external measurements; only current auto/model is paired A/B
reference_comparison.drift_note: Auto latency ratios are raw timing observations, not clock measurements, frequency-normalized latencies, or a correction applied to the results
